criteria.scenario: A monthly billing SMS must be sent once per child/per period to each unique eligible guardian number, including when the amount is zero. Contact relationships come from a legacy system, while billing eligibility is decided by Finance. The business also wants an operator approval step before mass sending.
criteria.decision_to_make: Produce traceable, testable requirements and acceptance scenarios without prematurely choosing transport architecture.
must_do: separate legacy contact source from Finance eligibility rules
must_not_do: encode a specific queue/provider as a requirement unless it is a hard constraint
turn unknown policy into a confirmed rule

criteria.scenario: Staging is deployed from a Docker image tagged with the commit, but some frontend build flags are injected through Docker ARG/ENV and a developer can rebuild a different image from the same branch before production. Database migration files are in the repo.
criteria.decision_to_make: Define artifact provenance, gate chain and migration/config handling.
must_do: build once and promote the same immutable artifact where possible
distinguish build-time config from secrets/runtime config
must_not_do: rebuild different bytes for production and call them verified
